name: typecho
description: Typecho blog rewrite with Astro + Cloudflare Workers + D1

DB.description: D1 database for posts, pages, comments, users, and site options. Tables are created by the `/install` wizard, not by Wrangler migrations.

BUCKET.description: R2 bucket for uploaded media files (images, attachments).

INSTALL_TOKEN.description: Recommended. Protects `/install` so only people with this token can create the first administrator. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`. Leave empty only for private tests — anyone who opens `/install` first can become admin.

scripts.deploy: node scripts/ensure-queues.mjs && pnpm run build && pnpm exec wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:dry-run: pnpm run build && pnpm exec wrangler deploy --dry-run
scripts.typecheck: wrangler types worker-configuration.d.ts && astro sync && tsc --noEmit
